technology_name: A METHOD FOR MAKING AUTHENTICATION ENCRYPTION SCHEMES ROBUST AGAINST DIFFERENTIAL FAULT ATTACKS
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Hardware cryptographic blocks are highly vulnerable to differential fault analysis attacks, where hardware side-channel voltage glitches are introduced to leak secret operational keys.
description: An advanced cryptographic fortification methodology deploying programmable cellular automata (PCA) arrays directly over target hardware modules like ASCON, Elephant, and TinyJambu to intercept fault variations instantly.
applications: Secure banking payment microchip modules, consumer smart device authenticators, aerospace hardware security modules (HSMs), and defense telecommunication routers.
secondary_sector: Infrastructure, Construction & Smart Cities, Consumer & Lifestyle Products
